2.web: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
2.asv: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

3.web: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
3.asv: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.

4.web: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
4.asv: Let us choose for us that which is right: Let us know among ourselves what is good.

5.web: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
5.asv: For Job hath said, I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right:

6.web: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
6.asv: Notwithstanding my right I am accounted a liar; My wound is incurable, though I amwithout transgression.

7.web: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
7.asv: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scoffing like water,

8.web: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
8.asv: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men?

9.web: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
9.asv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.

10.web: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
10.asv: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

11.web: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
11.asv: For the work of a man will he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.

12.web: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
12.asv: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

13.web: Who put him in charge of the earth? or who has appointed him over the whole world?
13.asv: Who gave him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

14.web: If he set his heart on himself, If he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
14.asv: If he set his heart upon himself, Ifhe gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

15.web: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
15.asv: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.

16.web: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
16.asv: If nowthou hastunderstanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.

17.web: Shall even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
17.asv: Shall even one that hateth justice govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is righteous and mighty?—

18.web: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
18.asv: Himthat saith to a king, Thou art vile, Orto nobles, Ye arewicked;

19.web: Who doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respects the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.
19.asv: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor; For they all are the work of his hands.

20.web: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
20.asv: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand.

21.web: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
21.asv: For his eyes are upon the ways of a man, And he seeth all his goings.

22.web: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
22.asv: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

23.web: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
23.asv: For he needeth not further to consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.

24.web: He breaks in pieces mighty men in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
24.asv: He breaketh in pieces mighty men in ways past finding out, And setteth others in their stead.

25.web: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
25.asv: Therefore he taketh knowledge of their works; And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

26.web: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
26.asv: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;

27.web: because they turned aside from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
27.asv: Because they turned aside from following him, And would not have regard in any of his ways:

28.web: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
28.asv: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heard the cry of the afflicted.

29.web: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? Alike whether to a nation, or to a man,
29.asv: When he giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Alike whether it be done unto a nation, or unto a man:

30.web: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
30.asv: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.

31.web: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
31.asv: For hath any said unto God, I have bornechastisement, I will not offend any more:

32.web: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
32.asv: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more?

33.web: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
33.asv: Shall his recompense be as thou wilt, that thou refusest it? For thou must choose, and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.

34.web: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
34.asv: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:

35.web: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
35.asv: Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.

36.web: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
36.asv: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.

37.web: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
37.asv: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin; He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.
